block.neroevents.event_console.tooltip: Shows what is happening on this server and lets you vote and claim rewards.
console.neroevents.cancel_event.body: Everyone sees it called off, and nobody is paid for it.
console.neroevents.cancel_event.help: Operator: call this event off for everyone.
console.neroevents.cancel_event.title: Cancel %s?
console.neroevents.claim.done: Claimed — %s stacks are in your inventory.
console.neroevents.claim.help: Put everything from your reward crate into your inventory.
console.neroevents.claim.partial: Claimed what fits. %s stacks still wait: make room and claim again.
console.neroevents.deny.no_answer: The server didn't answer — try again
console.neroevents.deny.not_at_console: Stand at the console to do that
console.neroevents.deny.too_fast: One moment — try again in a second
console.neroevents.deny.voting_off: Voting is off on this server
console.neroevents.gear.help: Move or hide the event messages on your screen. Press %s to hide them until the next change.
console.neroevents.live.empty: Nothing is happening right now. The next event is on the Soon tab.
console.neroevents.mine.credits_note: Credits go straight to your account.
console.neroevents.mine.ledger_off: This server keeps no reward history.
console.neroevents.mine.none: Nothing earned in the last %s days. Take part in an event to earn rewards.
console.neroevents.mine.opted_out: You opted out, so rewards are not remembered past this session.
console.neroevents.privacy.erase.body: This opens the chat with the erase command for every Neroland mod; press Enter to send it. Unclaimed rewards are lost, so claim them first.
console.neroevents.privacy.erase.help: Erase everything Neroland keeps about you (asks first).
console.neroevents.privacy.erase.title: Erase everything Neroland keeps about you?
console.neroevents.privacy.explain.erase: Erase opens the chat with the erase command for every Neroland mod. Claim your rewards first.
console.neroevents.privacy.explain.expor: Export saves everything NeroEvents holds about you as one file the server operator can hand you.
console.neroevents.privacy.explain.optou: Opt out: you still get rewards. New rewards aren't stored under your id (items wait in a temporary crate until the server restarts). Rows from before expire as normal, or use Erase.
console.neroevents.privacy.export.help: Save everything NeroEvents holds about you as one file.
console.neroevents.privacy.export_done: Saved your data file in the world folder. Ask the server operator for it.
console.neroevents.privacy.export_failed: The export did not work. Try again later.
console.neroevents.privacy.export_wait: You can export again in %s seconds.
console.neroevents.privacy.ledger_off: This server keeps no reward history, so there is nothing to opt out of.
console.neroevents.privacy.optin_done: Opted in: your rewards are remembered again.
console.neroevents.privacy.optout.help: Stop remembering your rewards. You still get them.
console.neroevents.privacy.optout_done: Opted out: new rewards are no longer stored under your id.
console.neroevents.privacy.row.ledger: who you are, the event, what you got, when — %s days
console.neroevents.privacy.row.ledger_op: not kept for you: you opted out
console.neroevents.privacy.row.not_kept: where you were, how you voted, who else took part.
console.neroevents.soon.admin_mode: On this server only operators start events.
console.neroevents.soon.empty: Nothing is coming up yet. Events are announced here before they start.
console.neroevents.subtitle.live: Events running now and what to do
console.neroevents.subtitle.mine: What you earned and what is waiting for you
console.neroevents.subtitle.past: The last events, in plain words
console.neroevents.subtitle.privacy: What this server keeps about you
console.neroevents.subtitle.soon: Coming up — vote if the server asks you to
console.neroevents.tab.mine.help: Your rewards and the claim button
console.neroevents.tab.privacy.help: What this server keeps about you
console.neroevents.title: What's happening on this server
console.neroevents.todo.generic: Take part to earn a share — %s
